title: LUMEN SKINCARE
sub: Clean beauty flagship, editorial layouts, organic palette
line: Redefining clean beauty: a bespoke digital experience blending editorial layouts with an organic palette.
ov1: A skincare house asked for a flagship that feels like porcelain under gallery light. We built an editorial system around negative space, water texture and one cinematic key light.
result: The launch site carries the full line on a single scroll: ingredient stories, ritual pages and a checkout that never breaks the calm. Every product frame was generated under the same key light, so the catalogue reads as one shoot.

title: NOCTURNE DINING
line: A tasting menu told in candlelight: reservation flow, menu narrative and cellar archive in one continuous scroll.
ov1: A fine-dining room with one candle per table needed a site as dark and patient as its service. Typography carries the menu; light carries the mood.
result: Reservations moved from a third-party widget into the story itself. The seasonal menu is a scroll-driven sequence, and the cellar archive doubles as the sommelier's working list.

title: WILDER CAMP
sub: Expedition-grade gear under a blue-hour sky
line: Expedition-grade gear presented at blue hour, with lantern light doing the selling.
ov1: An outdoor label wanted dusk, not daylight. We built the catalogue around glowing canvas, cold air and warm interiors.
result: A catalogue that behaves like a campsite at nightfall: products glow, specs stay quiet until asked, and the trip planner ties gear lists to real routes.

title: IRONFLOW LUBRICANTS
sub: Heavy industry through a macro lens
line: Heavy industry through a macro lens: viscosity, sheen and torque as brand assets.
ov1: An industrial group asked us to make oil beautiful. Macro photography and slow ripples turned a commodity into a visual signature.
result: Datasheets became scroll stories. Each product page opens on a macro loop of the fluid itself, then hands off to a spec table engineers can actually read.

title: CANE & FORM
sub: Rattan craft, raking light, long shadows
line: Rattan weave under raking light: a craft catalogue with long shadows and longer patience.
ov1: A furniture workshop wanted its weave seen, not described. Side light and shadow do the talking across the collection.
result: The collection is presented as a slow walk through a lit workshop. Material close-ups sit beside room-scale renders, and the trade portal lives behind the same visual language.

title: PULL NOODLE BAR
sub: Hand-pulled craft, flour dust in the light shaft
line: Hand-pulled craft caught mid-air: flour dust in a single shaft of light.
ov1: A noodle house with a queue around the block needed a site that moves like the kitchen: fast, precise, theatrical.
result: Ordering is three taps and one animation. The menu is shot as a single kitchen sequence, and the queue page tells waiting guests exactly how long until their bowl.

title: AXIOM PRECISION
line: CNC tolerances as brand language: titanium, coolant spray and sparks of white light.
ov1: A machining firm asked for proof of precision. We answered with macro frames of the work itself, measured to the micron.
result: Capabilities are shown, not claimed: every process page opens on the machine at work. The quote flow reads a CAD upload and returns a scoped estimate within the same session.

title: FORGELINE STEEL
line: Foundry glow as the only colour in a monochrome world.
ov1: A steel group wanted scale and heat. Molten orange against near-black structure became the entire art direction.
result: A group site for six divisions that shares one temperature. Project archives, investor pages and careers all sit inside the same monochrome frame with one glowing accent.

title: CLARA AESTHETICS
line: Clinical calm behind frosted glass: a corridor of soft light and quiet confidence.
ov1: A clinic asked for trust at first scroll. Charcoal tones and one glowing door set the temperature for every treatment page.
result: Treatment pages lead with the room, not the procedure. Booking is one calm panel, consultations are explained in plain language, and nothing on the site raises the pulse.

title: HELIOS ENERGY
line: Night arrays reflecting the moon: solar told through geometry and silence.
ov1: An energy company wanted the poetry of the panel field, not the datasheet. We shot the array at night and let geometry speak.
result: Live generation data feeds a night-mode dashboard that looks like the array itself. Investor and community pages share the same silence, with numbers appearing only when the reader asks.
